question: Does knowledge of the tetrad establish someone as a guru?
premises: A person may know the tetrad.
Discerning knowledge of this tetrad is the criterion.
Such a knower is declared a guru.
inference: Knowing the tetrad qualifies a person to be declared a guru.
uncertainties: The specific contents of the tetrad are not identified in this verse.
plain_english: O beloved, whoever knows the tetrad is declared to be a guru.
